# Blood Pressure Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Recording of current blood pressure with systolic/diastolic readings.

**Also known as:** BP Event

## Scope note

Narrower than HealthEvent; a single blood-pressure reading, distinct from GlucoseEvent, InsulinEvent, and EKGEvent.

## Broader

- [HealthEvent](../HealthEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
